title: The high dimensional psychological profile and cultural bias of ChatGPT
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the model's score on the moral dimension of 'sanctity', which was used as an indicator for its emphasis on religious beliefs as part of a larger psychological profile assessment.
findings: In terms of moral judgment, ChatGPT scored lower than humans in the dimension of sanctity, 'indicating a relatively diminished emphasis on religious beliefs'.
